entries.source: $('#project').onsubmit=async e=>{e.preventDefault();const f=new FormData(e.target);if(await act('project',{ip:f.get('ip'),name:f.get('name'),era:f.get('era'),story:Number(f.get('story')),source_song:f.get('source_song'),inherit_revisions:f.getAll('inherit').map(Number),inherit_reason:f.get('inherit_reason'),clone_structure:f.get('clone_structure')==='on'},f.get('name')))$('#projectDialog').close()};$('#shot').onsubmit=async e=>{e.preventDefault();const f=new FormData(e.target);shotName=f.get('shot');await act('shot',{song:song(),shot:shotName,description:f.get('description')})};$('#upload').onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();if(project()?.shots[shotName])upload(e.target,'take');else message('샷을 먼저 추가하세요.',true)};$('#audioUpload').onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();upload(e.target,'audio')};$('#shotlist').onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-shot]');if(b){shotName=b.dataset.shot;draw()}};$('#takes').addEventListener('focusin',e=>{const button=e.target.closest('button[data-take]');if(button)revealTakeFocus($('#takes'),button)});$('#takes').onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-take]');if(b)act('select',{song:song(),shot:shotName,take:Number(b.dataset.take),shot_revision:project().shots[shotName].revision})};$('#songs').onchange=()=>{if(dirty&&!confirm('저장하지 않은 편집을 버리고 작품을 전환할까요?')){$('#songs').value=decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1));return}draft=null;dirty=false;draw();drawJobs()};$('#sync').onclick=()=>{if(!project())return;draft=fresh(project());dirty=true;drawTimeline()};
